subject: Request: Pen test summary & remediation status following suspicious auths
messages:
From: Elena Gonzalez <elena.gonzalez@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected auth activity — request for pen test report and remediation status

Hi Aditya,

We observed several anomalous authentication events on 2026-08-01 coming from a service account that calls Redwood's API (see attached snippet). Our security team has opened an incident review and we need to collect vendor evidence as soon as possible. Can you please share the following:

- The most recent penetration test executive summary or redacted report (PDF preferred)
- Test date and exact in-scope assets (API endpoints, infra, eval infra, etc.)
- Any CVEs or findings, and confirmation of remediation status and dates
- Whether any customer data could have been exposed (even in logs)

If the full report requires an NDA, we can sign — please point me to the process. We need files for our internal incident review by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Elena Gonzalez
Director, Information Security
Greenline Health

Attachments: audit_log_snippet.csv
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected auth activity — request for pen test report and remediation status

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the log snippet. I'm escalating to our security team (cc'd) to provide the pen test summary and remediation details. Rishi — can you triage and share the redacted exec summary + remediation timeline? Also, Elena said they need evidence by EOD tomorrow — is 24-48h feasible for a redacted PDF?

Elena, I'll follow up with a link for an NDA if necessary (Monica can help expedite DocuSign).

Best,
Aditya Rao

aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gonzalez <elena.gonzalez@greenlinehealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected auth activity — request for pen test report and remediation status

Hi Elena / Aditya,

Thanks for the escalation. Brief summary up front: our most recent third-party penetration test was run by GreyMatter Security and completed on 2026-05-18. The assessed scope included:
- Hosted API endpoints that process inference requests (production clusters)
- Management/control plane endpoints used by the Redwood Console
- Supporting infra (load balancers, key-management access patterns)

Findings: no critical-level remote code execution (RCE) or unauthenticated data exfiltration were identified. Several medium/low findings were reported, primarily around configuration hardening and dependency patching. All medium findings were remediated and verified between 2026-05-21 and 2026-06-10.

Regarding your specific ask: we can provide a redacted executive summary (suitable for vendor risk review) and a remediation plan summary immediately. The full, unredacted report is only available under a standard NDA and DPA addendum; we require a signed access form and a point of contact for secure delivery. If you can sign an NDA, we can provide the full report via a secure portal.

I have attached an exec summary we can release now after one quick redaction pass (PII and internal IP addresses removed) and a remediation plan doc with dates. To answer your explicit question: there is no evidence that customer data was exposed during the assessed period or in relation to the findings documented in the pen test. The anomalous auths you saw look like credential misuse or a misconfigured service token on Greenline's side (we can help correlate logs if you share request IDs).

Attachments: redwood_greymatter_execsum_20260518.pdf (redacted), redwood_remediation_plan_20260801.docx

If you'd like the unredacted report, please send a signed NDA to security-access@redwood.com; I can provision portal access once we have that. For immediate needs, the attached exec summary + remediation plan should satisfy vendor risk.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0224
From: Elena Gonzalez <elena.gonzalez@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected auth activity — request for pen test report and remediation status

Rishi, thank you for the fast response and for the clear summary. A couple quick follow-ups: 

- We'll sign an NDA for access to the full report — please send the DocuSign link to my attention (Elena G.).
- The executive summary and remediation plan should be sufficient for immediate triage and our vendor risk board; please flag any items that require coordination with our SREs.
- Can you confirm whether the remediation that closed in June included rolling patch updates to the inference runtime and the KV cache handling? That was a concern raised by our team.

We did not see obvious signs of data exfiltration, but want to be thorough. I can share a few request IDs offline for correlation (prefer secure channel). Thanks again.

Elena Gonzalez
Director, Information Security
Greenline Health
